D/ IMP CARAVSIVS [...] ; R/ MONETA AVG

A Roman copper alloy radiate of Carausius, c. AD 286-293 (Reece Period 14), Obverse legend: IMP CARAVSIVS [...], reverse legend: MONETA AVG. Possibly C Mint, [ ] C? //[?]. Diameter: 24mm, weight: 3.75g. This coin has been considered for Sam Moorhead's corpus for RIC
